<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Click dark gray diamond center
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 59, 'col': 27}])
print(f"done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
g_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'G')
print(f"G objects: {g_count}")

# Find all G pixel positions
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'G':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"G: ({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)}), px={n['pixels']}")

# Check white diamond
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 12:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"White diamond: ({min(rows)},{min(cols)})-({max(rows)},{max(cols)})")

# ASCII area
ascii_grid = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\n=== Target area ===")
for r in range(54, 63):
    print(f"  Row {r}: {ascii_grid[r][23:33]}")

# If not done, try clicking purple ring again
if not last_action_result.get('done'):
    result2 = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 21, 'col': 39}])
    print(f"\nAfter ring click: done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    g_count2 = sum(1 for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'G')
    print(f"G objects: {g_count2}")
    
    for r in range(54, 63):
        print(f"  Row {r}: {ascii_grid[r][23:33]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
